feature: Main-only repository delivery and branch reconciliation
route: GitHub repository branch refs and rulesets

flows.name: Prevent a non-main branch push
steps: Attempt to create a unique non-main branch ref
Attempt the local pre-push branch path
flows.expectedOutcome: Both GitHub and local delivery paths fail loudly before a non-main branch can be created.

flows.name: Reconcile historic refs without loss
steps: Publish an archive tag for each original branch tip
Promote current intended commits to main
Delete the corresponding remote branch refs
Read back main, tags, ruleset, and branch inventory
flows.expectedOutcome: Only main remains as a remote branch and every retired tip is recoverable from an immutable archive tag.

checks: The reconciliation receipt visibly names the live policy, main-only branch state, and recovery tags.

claims.description: GitHub rejects creation of a non-main branch ref.
The local hook and publish command reject non-main delivery.
Every retired branch tip is retained by an archive tag and intended current work is on main.
The canonical reconciliation receipt visibly states the policy and recovery state.
